newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGIP, parent sell 2.4 mln Cap Gemini shares.
newsitem.headline: CGIP, parent sell 2.4 mln Cap Gemini shares.

text.p: French holding company CGIP said it and its parent company had sold a total of 2.4 million shares in Cap Gemini to institutions on Wednesday at 234 francs per share.
The combined sale of two million shares held directly by CGIP and 400,000 held by its parent Marine-Wendel covers 3.98 percent of Cap Gemini's capital, CGIP said in a statement.
CGIP said it retained a 20 percent shareholding in Cap Gemini, an information services and software company, following the sale.
The sale by placement to both French and foreign institutional investors was handled jointly by HSBC Investment Banking and Merrill Lynch International, it said.
On Tuesday, CGIP chairman Ernest-Antoine Seilliere told a news conference about the company's acquisition of a 20 percent stake in car parts group Valeo that CGIP could sell some assets.
